description: Enrichment pipeline for NiFi flow performance - calculates throughput rates and efficiency metrics

script.description: Convert processing nanos to millis and calculate averages
script.source: if (ctx.processingNanos != null) { ctx.processingMillis = ctx.processingNanos / 1000000.0; if (ctx.invocations != null && ctx.invocations > 0) { ctx.avgProcessingMillis = ctx.processingMillis / (double)ctx.invocations; } }

if (ctx.queuedCount != null && ctx.backpressureObjectThreshold != null && ctx.backpressureObjectThreshold > 0) { ctx.queueUtilization = (ctx.queuedCount / (double)ctx.backpressureObjectThreshold) * 100.0; }
if (ctx.invocations != null && ctx.processingMillis != null && ctx.processingMillis > 0) { ctx.processingEfficiency = ctx.invocations / ctx.processingMillis; }
